info.title: HR Playground API
info.description: Multi-tenant HR performance API (learning project). Log in with POST /auth/login; the session cookie is then sent automatically. Seeded users use password123.

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: One review per employee per cycle

cookieAuth.description: Session JWT set by POST /auth/login (httpOnly, so you never handle it in JS).
